name: M1-2A-03, 1B
headline: Exotic 1BDR w/ Outdoor Terrace | Pool & Beach Access
summary: This colorful 1 bedroom apartment is located in Gouna's only beachfront compound with a 24/7 free pool and beach access and is managed by Xuru Stays

description.Space:
This exotic and colorful 1 bedroom apartment is located in Gouna's only beachfront residence - Mangroovy with a 24/7 free pool and beach access. Mangroovy is closest to the Marina (10 min walk). 

The apartment is on the ground floor and features an open plan fully equipped kitchen, 2 bathrooms (one ensuite) and a living room. There is a bright a cosy outdoor furnished terrace, perfect for your morning coffee or late night relaxation. 

It also features a 55 inch smart TV with Airplay and cable channels, washing machine, a Nespresso machine, kettle and a microwave. The apartment is great for couples & small families. 

The styling of the apartment is tailored to give the guests an exotic and happy vibe.


At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Access: Guests have access to the entire apartment
description.Interaction:
We are more than happy to answer all of your questions 24/7. Guests can text and call anytime they need help and our team will be there in about 30 mins to solve any issue immediately.

At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Neighborhood:
-Mangroovy residence is uniquely located 800 meters from Marina El Gouna. Guests will be able to walk 10 minutes and get to it. 
-'Bright Star' supermarket is right in front of the residence towards the Marina.
-Mangroovy is home to the famous 'Noi' beach lounge (located at Mangroovy's beach)
- 'The Smokery', a local favorite is also located 450 meters from the residence.
description.Transit:
Free outdoor parking is available. 
Tuktuks are available to take you anywhere in El Gouna (flat fee 20 EGP).
description.Notes: Please note that smoking is not allowed inside the apartment. A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.

agreement:
Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 100 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from community security office, guests will be fully refunded).
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 


Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

reviews.review: The reason we stay with Xuru Stays is consistency.  Knowing what to expect before you walk out the door, takes much of the worry and stress away of wondering if you will walk into a disaster.  John, Mina, Christina and their local team at Xuru are constantly working very hard to bring their guests the smoothest and most comfortable experience possible.  We were the first couple to stay in this newly renovated flat and it was exactly the perfect setup for a quiet and peaceful holiday.  Everything in the flat is brand new.  There are little touches here and there that shows they went the extra distance to give the flat that warm, welcoming, modern feel. The colors on the accent walls and the paradise-themed wall paper, along with the carefully placed plants, give it a vibrant, refreshing feeling of bringing nature directly inside.  The TV is the perfect size on the wall across from a sectional couch that doubles as a bed.  There were only 2 of us so we didn't need to pull it out but you can see that from the pictures, especially if you had children or company.  The cube mirror on the wall off from the kitchen is perfectly hung and spaced on each side, which provides added depth to the room.  That level of precision means someone cared to make sure it was done correctly.  Those are the little things to me that separate all the other available places out there from the rest.  The decorations on the walls are all fun and modern and give the flat that added bonus of not just looking at 4 blank walls.  The coffee table is the perfect size and color and the rug underneath it is fantastic.  The wifi is solid and stable and there is cable tv and Netflix built-in for your viewing pleasure.  The wardrobe in the bedroom provides plenty of space for your belongings.  The kitchen table is the perfect size for the space and can also double as a desk if you need to work and setup your pc.  There are 2 massive sliding doors that lead out to the outside sitting area, one in the main room and one in the bedroom.  Both have screens to allow for the amazing Gouna breeze to come in.  Outside you will find a chair-swing and additional sectional outdoor furniture for you to relax.  There is great sun that hits that outside area all morning and you are just steps away from the most amazing pool ever.  This is a ground-floor unit and you can pull your vehicle right up and unload very easily.  The overall level of cleanliness in the flat is immaculate.  This is the place to be.  We can't wait to return back and visit.  Thanks again to Xuru for making our holiday an unforgettable experience!

أسوأ تجربة مرّت عليّ على الإطلاق ❌
أنا شخص بسافر بشكل مستمر، ونزلت الجونة أكثر من مرة قبل كده، وعندي خبرة كويسة بنظام الحجز والدخول هناك، لكن بكل صراحة دي كانت أسوأ تجربة حصلت لي.
حجزت وحدة في الجونة عن طريق شركة Xuru Stays قبلها بـ 48 ساعة، وكنت متابع موضوع الـ QR Code، لكن للأسف ما تمش إرساله قبل الوصول، وده سبب مشكلة كبيرة عند الدخول.
لما وصلت، تم منعي من الدخول واضطريت أستنى حوالي ساعة ونص على البوابة، في وضع مرهق جدًا ومحرج.
سألت أمن الجونة مباشرة، وأكدوا إن الـ QR Code المفروض بيتم إصداره خلال 24 ساعة كحد أقصى، وده معناه إن التأخير كان واضح إنه من طرف الشركة.
المشكلة مش في التأخير بس، لكن في طريقة التعامل بالكامل: مفيش أي مرونة، مفيش مسؤولية، وكل الردود كانت ثابتة: “دي سياستنا”.
طلبت أدخل الساعة 12 بدل 3 بعد كل الوقت اللي اتأخرت فيه بسببهم، وده طلب طبيعي جدًا في الظروف دي، لكن الرد كان فقط: “لو عايز دخول بدري لازم تدفع”.
مع إني وضحت إن التأخير من عندهم وإن اللي حصل سبب لي إرهاق وضياع وقت، مفيش أي تفهم أو محاولة حل، وكان في تعنت غير مبرر تمامًا.
